def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Grid separators are the rows/columns containing few or no background (9) cells.
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != 9 for v in row) > w * 0.55]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(h)) > h * 0.55]
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The ordinary separator color is the most frequent value at line intersections.
    intersections = [grid[r][c] for r in row_lines for c in col_lines]
    base = Counter(intersections).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = [(ri, ci) for ri, r in enumerate(row_lines)
              for ci, c in enumerate(col_lines) if grid[r][c] != base]
    if not marked:
        return []

    r0 = min(ri for ri, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(ri for ri, _ in marked)
    c0 = min(ci for _, ci in marked)
    c1 = max(ci for _, ci in marked)
    out = []
    for ri in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(c0, c1):
            corners = [grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci + 1]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci + 1]]]
            color = corners[0]
            row.append(color if color != base and all(v == color for v in corners) else 9)
        out.append(row)

 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if sum(v != 9 for v in row) > w * 0.55]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w)
                 if sum(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(h)) > h * 0.55]
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    base = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in row_lines for c in col_lines).most_common(1)[0][0]

    cells = []
    for ri in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = (grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci + 1]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci + 1]])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != base and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else 9)
        cells.append(row)

    occupied = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(cells)
                for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 9]
    if not occupied:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in occupied), max(r for r, _ in occupied)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in occupied), max(c for _, c in occupied)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in cells[r0:r1 + 1]]
"
